name: @agent-wiki-toolbox/quartz-folder-notes
description: Serves a note sitting beside a folder of its own name as that folder's landing page, at the address the toolbox index gives it

quartz.name: awt-folder-notes
quartz.description: Emits `x.md` at `x/index` when a folder `x/` sits beside it, so the note is the folder's landing page instead of being shadowed by the generated listing. The address is read from the toolbox index, never recomputed.
